reply.message:
I couldn’t create a complete checked preview: the catalog returned no compatible, sized furniture for the living-room set. No products were selected or changes made.

The budget remains unconfirmed. Once products are available, I’ll inspect their renders before proposing purchases. Alternatively, I can rearrange your existing furniture for a calmer, cozier feel without buying anything.
